entries.description: Audited current app dependencies against the simplified notes-driven library handoff and captured remaining compatibility-era usage in docs/planning/notes-driven-app-dependency-audit.md.

Created the Session 1 migration map in docs/planning/notes-driven-app-dependency-audit.md, incorporating routed documentation output plus verifier feedback about report controls and deprecated-surface coverage.
Recorded the pages and layouts still carrying pre-simplification assumptions in docs/session-sets/notes-driven-app-alignment/alignment-baseline.md for Session 2 and Session 3 follow-on work.

Ran dotnet build and dotnet test for Dabbler.Platform.sln. The first pass hit transient file locks from shared build/test hosts, so the build servers were shut down and validation was rerun with node reuse disabled; build then succeeded and all 358 tests passed.
Ran mandatory external session verification and saved the raw review to session-reviews/session-001.md.
Aligned the product catalog compatibility route to the retained query-page workflow and removed app-side CSV export opt-ins from the product, customer, and order query pages.
Kept the app on the retained detail-form surfaces by routing product discovery back through the supported query workflow instead of maintaining a separate catalog-only browsing experience.
Removed explicit report viewer-control opt-ins from the report pages so the app now relies on the retained DabblerReportPage surface instead of app-specific compatibility-era settings.

Updated dashboard defaults in both the standalone dashboard page and shell dashboard resolver to use navigation cards, report links, and focused search without favorites or recent-items compatibility widgets, and added source guardrail tests for the new baseline.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln with node reuse disabled. Build succeeded with existing Dabbler.Security XML-comment warnings, and all 362 tests passed including AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests and Playwright coverage.
Ran mandatory external session verification and saved the raw review to session-reviews/session-002.md.

Aligned MainLayout and Program to remove catalog-provider and usage-tracking compatibility wiring from the default shell, replaced the top-level Catalog action with the focused Products route, and removed the unused popup compatibility plumbing.
Aligned admin navigation with the app's actual role model so BackofficeUserAdmin keeps user administration access while Product Management and Security Dashboard remain SystemAdmin-only.

Strengthened source, integration, and Playwright coverage around the focused products routes and admin security destinations so the app proves the supported notes-driven workflow paths without the old shell extras.
Confirmed a representative mutating workflow remains backend verified by preserving and rerunning the Playwright product-availability persistence check alongside the Session 3 route coverage.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln with node reuse disabled. Build succeeded and all 366 tests passed, including the strengthened AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web and Playwright coverage.
Ran mandatory external session verification and saved the raw review to session-reviews/session-003.md.

Created docs/planning/notes-driven-app-acceptance-baseline.md to capture the accepted app baseline after alignment, including the focused shell and dashboard defaults, the focused /products/catalog alias, retained query CSV export, retained report PDF export, and explicit compatibility boundaries.

Rebaselined docs/session-sets/notes-driven-template-encoding/spec.md around the accepted app baseline and confirmed that no catch-up session was required because the completed app state exposed no direct omission that belongs inside notes-driven-app-alignment.
Generated docs/session-sets/notes-driven-app-alignment/change-log.md to close the four-session set and capture the accepted app baseline handoff to downstream template work.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln with node reuse disabled. Build succeeded with the existing Dabbler.Security XML-comment warnings plus preview-SDK notices, and all 366 tests passed including AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web and Playwright coverage.
Ran mandatory external session verification and saved the raw review to session-reviews/session-004.md.
